Based on the viral book series by Elle Kennedy, the show is set at Briar University and follows the lives of the elite college ice hockey team. Season 1, titled The Deal, focuses on Hannah Wells, a music major who is seemingly the only girl on campus not interested in the hockey team. When star captain Garrett Graham needs to pass a philosophy class to keep his spot on the team, he strikes a deal with Hannah: she tutors him, and he helps her win over her crush by pretending to date her.

As their fake relationship plays out in the public eye, the lines between their agreement and reality begin to blur, forcing both to contront their past traumas and true feelings.

🎥Rockstar
Rockstar is not just a love story - it’s the journey of pain turning into passion. Directed by Imtiaz Ali, the film follows Jordan, played by Ranbir Kapoor, a simple boy who believes true art is born from heartbreak.
What starts as a chaotic college romance slowly becomes an emotional storm of love, separation, fame, and loneliness. Heer, played by Nargis Fakhri, becomes the soul of Jordan’s music and madness.
Unlike typical romantic films, Rockstar shows how love can heal and destroy someone at the same time.
The movie became unforgettable because of its raw emotions, deep dialogues, magical music by A. R. Rahman, and Ranbir Kapoor’s career-defining performance. Every song feels like a memory you never lived but somehow still miss.

Jaapani uue põlvkonna futuristic trap ja melodic drill skeenel on RYONEX tousnud üheks kõige tähelepanuväärsemaks nimeks. Tema kire flow, tumedad elektroonilised produktsioonid ja tugevalt cyberpunk’ist mõjutatud visuaalne stil on aidanud tal lühikese ajaga koguda märkimisvaarse kuulajaskonna. Eriti populaarne on ta noorte seas, kes jalgivad animekultuuri, videomänge ja internetipöhiseid kogukondi.
Lood nagu „Tokyo Fade” ja „Chrome Heart” on toonud talle miljoneid kuulamisi ning koostöö erinevate Aasia produtsentidega on laiendanud tema mõju veelgi. Tema kontsertidel kasutatakse sageli glitch-efekte, futuristlikke visuaale ja julisi bite, mis on muutunud oluliseks osaks artisti äratuntavast identiteedist.
2026. aastat peetakse RYONEXi karjaarıs oluliseks
pöördepunktiks. Praegu koguvad suurt tähelepanu nii tema jargmise albumi filmilikud teaserid kui ka ettevalmistused suuremateks festivaliesinemisteks Tokyos ja Soulis. Paljud fännid usuvad, et just see periood võib viia ta Aasia kaasaegse trap-muusika kõige môjukamate artıstide hulka.

🎬✨ Little Women ‧ (2019)

A heartfelt coming-of-age drama based on the classic novel by Louisa May Alcott. The story follows the four March sisters—Jo, Meg, Beth, and Amy—as they grow up during and after the American Civil War. Each sister has a unique personality and dream: Jo wants to become a writer, Meg seeks a simple family life, Beth is gentle and selfless, and Amy dreams of becoming an artist.

In 19th century Massachusetts, the March sisters--Meg, Jo, Beth, and Amy--on the threshold of womanhood, go through many ups and downs in life and endeavor to make important decisions about their futures.
